references.context: During Mega Visor, hit Visor targets 25 times.
references.label: Visor targets
references.description: The five front targets and five side targets fill the colored grid.

references.context: Lock one ball in each Eye to start the first two-ball Multiball.
references.label: Eye locks
references.description: The two saucers behind the Visor lock balls and score Jackbots.

references.context: Shoot the Game Saucer to relight both Eyes, Cashier, and Hit Me.
references.label: Game Saucer
references.description: The back-left saucer starts casino games and relights Jackbots.

references.context: Shoot the Game Saucer to relight both Eyes, Cashier, and Hit Me.
references.label: Cashier target
references.description: The target below the raised left ramp scores Jackbots and Double or Nothing.

references.context: Shoot the Game Saucer to relight both Eyes, Cashier, and Hit Me.
references.label: Hit Me target
references.description: The lower-right standup scores blackjack cards and a lit Jackbot.

references.context: After the Super Jackbot opens the Eyes, lock one ball if two remain or two balls if three remain. Then shoot the lowered left ramp within 20 seconds.
references.label: Left ramp
references.description: The ramp raises during normal play and lowers for the Mega Jackbot shot.
